allocation.content: Controller owns state and gate enforcement; Reviewer supplies a judgment without request-mutation access. Separating these permissions prevents review logic from bypassing stage conditions.

fields.components: Controller initiates work and maintains flow state and gates. Reviewer supplies a judgment and cannot mutate the request.
fields.interfaces: Controller passes a request identifier to Reviewer only in Review after readable, complete Prepare input; Reviewer returns a judgment that Controller records before completion. The interface grants no request-mutation access.

projection.content: Source allocation is planned and subject to implementation review.

fields.behavior: Validate Plan and construct initial Run; Controller then checks Prepare input, advances to Review only after its gate, invokes Reviewer in Review, records the designated judgment and completes only after that gate.
fields.source_projection: src/example/factory.rs is a proposed implementation location, not an existing artifact.
fields.constraints: The caller serializes access; concurrency is outside this example.

trace.content: The context model and planned cases are review inputs, not proof of implementation.

fields.model_elements: Package Example supplies participant context only; it declares no sample-flow realization.
fields.verification_links: Planned checks cover empty plans, repeated stages, first-stage initialization and invalid judgment-interface calls outside Review or without complete Prepare; verify no request mutation and no completion without a recorded judgment. None has executed.
fields.unresolved_items: Concurrency and durable recovery remain outside the fictional example.
